description: cinatra-ai org-wide Renovate defaults. Repos extend this as local>cinatra-ai/.github:renovate-config.

packageRules.description: cinatra-ai/ci reusable-workflow callers are double-pinned (uses:@<sha> plus a with.ref input set to the same SHA). Renovate only rewrites the uses: half, so an automated update would silently diverge the two pins. Internal ci pins are bumped by coordinated org rollout waves instead.

cinatra-ai/.github reusable-workflow callers that pin an UNTAGGED main snapshot carry a synthetic `-main.<shortsha>` version comment (no matching git tag exists). Renovate's github-tags datasource cannot resolve that pseudo-version, so it reports fleet-wide 'Could not determine new digest' package-lookup failures. Suppress updates for the snapshot pins only; a pin that names a real published tag is unaffected and stays Renovate-maintained. When a real tag ships at or above the snapshot, repin the caller (SHA + real-tag comment) and this rule stops matching.
Hold TypeScript at the typescript-eslint peer ceiling until typescript-eslint ships TS7 support. Lift when supported.

Hold pnpm below 11 on repos that have not migrated yet. pnpm 11 changed the default for the lockfile's `settings.autoInstallPeers`, so once Renovate bumps `packageManager` to pnpm 11 the corepack-driven `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in CI aborts with ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH against a lockfile written by pnpm 10 — before any lint or test runs (cinatra-ai/plane-connector#48). It does not self-heal: Renovate's own lockfile regeneration fails the same way. matchCurrentValue scopes the cap to callers that are still on pnpm 10 or older: the negated regex exempts any plain version whose major is 11 or above, so a repo that has already migrated keeps normal currency (and cannot be re-capped by a later major), while a non-plain value such as a `^10.0.0` range stays capped rather than falling through. Each repo therefore leaves this rule by itself once its packageManager and lockfile are moved to pnpm 11 together. Lift entirely when the org-wide pnpm 11 migration is scheduled as an upgrade-track item.
